THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE WISH

A shared belief
in something more.

We started A Rare Wish with a simple idea: the best journeys aren’t measured in miles, but in how deeply they make you feel.

We’re Hasan and Rahil. Travellers at heart, perfectionists by nature, and personally invested in every wish we bring to life.

“Luxury isn’t what you spend.
It’s how deeply you remember it.”
